claim: Measure local observed costs for an explicitly restricted additive task; never infer full product or institutional advantage.
precision: integer cents; ASCII decimal input; no float quantity arithmetic
events: Repeated deposit(q), transfer(q), withdrawal(q); complete triples cancel, the zero/two partial suffix events have an analytic integer oracle. Four investors rotate. No corrections or revisions.
cut: Single static economic and knowledge cut; every expected record visible.
order: Seeded random three-method order in even blocks, reversed previous order in odd blocks; matched by size/repeat/seed/input SHA-256.
warmup: One 100-event process per method, recorded separately and excluded from summaries.
cold_warm: Fresh database and interpreter each trial; OS page cache not dropped. Do not label cold-disk latency.
reference_independence: Closed-form canceling-cycle oracle does not import production code. Stdlib event arithmetic and SQLite UNION/SUM are separate; reference ingestion and strict decimal parser are shared and this dependency limits independence.

timing.production_reconcile: Public reconcile call includes persistence; a test-owned Store subclass measures save_run and reports its duration separately without altering source or transactions.
timing.end_to_end: Child work from input read through correctness verification; parent subprocess wall includes interpreter startup and child artifact hashing, but excludes parent cleanup. Whole-program wall/CPU includes warmups, generation, hashing, cleanup and statistics. Phase progress logging is included instrumentation overhead. Do not add reconcile_including_persist to its two exclusive components.
timing.rss: Linux child ru_maxrss is KiB; includes interpreter/runtime and all phases, not isolated net allocations.
timing.disk: Logical file sizes; excludes filesystem metadata, block allocation and hardware writes. Not actual physical IO or monetary cost.

statistics.p95: Empirical nearest-rank percentile; n=5 means maximum and is not a reliable population tail estimate.
statistics.paired: production minus baseline wall seconds and production/baseline ratio for matching size/repeat/seed
statistics.interval: 2000 seeded paired-block bootstrap median resamples; 2.5/97.5 percentiles; five blocks only, exploratory and unstable
statistics.outliers: Retain every completed run; no outlier exclusion or replacement. Timeouts kept as censored outcomes, excluded from finite latency averages and explicitly counted.

acceptance: Every reported successful method's common result equals the closed-form integer oracle. Stop affected profile after any failure/timeout, retain evidence. Smaller profile failure blocks larger profiles. Fewer than five completed pairs yields INCONCLUSIVE.
retention: 100-event non-warmup databases/exports retained; larger and warmup files hashed and sized before removal. Input JSON, all commands/stdout/stderr, metrics, oracle result and retention inventory preserved. Timeout partial files are hashed before removal.
